contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP T AEL CAES HADR ANTONVS] ; R/ [AVG PIVS P M TR P COS II]

A Roman silver plated contemporary copy of a silver denarius of Antoninus Pius (AD 138 - 161), dating to AD 139 (Reece Period 7). AVG PIVS P M TR P COS II reverse type, depicting clasped hands holding caduceus possibly between two corn ears. Mint of Rome. RIC III, pg 29, no 26 or 27. Obverse description: Head right. Obverse inscription: [IMP T AEL CAES HADR ANTONVS]. Reverse description: Clasped…
